message:
No, I haven't -- what sort of perspective is Ostrom coming from?

I have to say, I was interested to see Shoshana Zuboff on your list of recent reviews -- her 1988 *In the Age of the Smart Machine* seemed to me to do some really interesting stuff anticipating the tech-will-change-consciousness work of Sherry Turkle et al., only with a much more cautious (and intelligently so, to my mind) or perhaps even cautionary perspective.
